body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> emtrace showcased its 4.7mm-thick digital photo frame ‘Photoskins’ during CES 2008. Adopting 2.5-inch color LCD display with 320 x 240 resolution and 4 controllable touch buttons, the Photoskins connects to the Internet via PC using a USB cable.
